name: B10-0298/2025 (ECR) – Dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling for action. It asks Mali's military rulers to bring back political parties, which were banned and then dissolved in 2024 and 2025. It also asks Mali to return to democratic, constitutional rule on a clear timetable, to respect free speech and association, and to stop intimidating opponents. It urges European Union countries to tie their support to progress on democracy, and calls for closer cooperation with African bodies.

- Mali's military government is urged to restore all political parties and free political activity.
- Malian citizens and opposition groups are affected; the European Union may link support to democratic progress.
- The Parliament asks the European Union to work with African Union and West African bloc ECOWAS on Mali's crisis.
